Retrieve Sample Summary Data

get_sample_summary.Rd

Extracts sample-level summary statistics from a Metabolites object for a specified data layer, with optional exclusions and subsetting.

Usage

get_sample_summary(
  metabolites,
  layer,
  sample_ids = NULL,
  drop = FALSE,
  as_df = FALSE
)

Arguments

metabolites

A Metabolites object containing sample summary data.

layer

A character string specifying the data layer from which to extract sample summary data.

sample_ids

Optional. A vector of column names (samples) to extract. Defaults to NULL, meaning all samples are included.

drop

Logical. Whether to drop all NA (excluded samples)

as_df

Logical. Whether to return the result as a data.frame. Defaults to FALSE, meaning the result is returned as a matrix.

Value

A matrix or data.frame (if as_df = TRUE) containing the sample summary data for the specified layer.

Examples

file <- system.file("extdata", "metabolon_v1_example.xlsx", package = "metaboprep2")
metabolites <- Metabolites(project_name = "MYPROJECT",
                           format       = "metabolon_v1",
                           filepath     = file)
metabolites <- import_data(metabolites)
#> Warning: 86 unmapped features:
#>  - 123, 124, 125, 126, 127, 128, 129, 130, 131, 132, 133, 134, 135, 137, 138, 139, 140, 141, 142, 143, 145, 146, 147, 148, 149, 150, 151, 152, 153, 154, 155, 156, 157, 159, 160, 161, 162, 163, 164, 165, 166, 167, 168, 169, 170, 172, 173, 174, 175, 176, 177, 178, 183, 184, 185, 186, 187, 188, 190, 191, 193, 195, 196, 198, 199, 200, 201, 202, 204, 205, 206, 207, 208, 209, 210, 211, 213, 214, 215, 216, 217, 218, 219, 220, 221, 222
